sample_unit: clinical cases (8,100 model responses across three prompting conditions)

links.outcome: Answer stability across medically equivalent SDoH-aware patient persona narratives with fixed answer key
links.effect: Narrative sensitivity error persisted in all models; the lowest error (Qwen2.5 7B) was still 31.67 percent. Best accuracy 56.33 percent; best correct consistency 40.33 percent.
links.quote: Even so, narrative sensitivity remains, with the lowest error still at 31.67 percent.

unlisted_practices: Evaluating medical LLMs on counterfactual consistency across medically equivalent patient narratives in addition to average accuracy
Comparing prompting conditions for effects on narrative sensitivity

screen.reason: Empirical benchmark evaluating LLM sensitivity and bias across different patient persona narratives (SDoH-aware narrative anchoring bias) on medical question answering datasets.
